Type: story
Description:
As a customer I want to pay an open invoice by card.
Acceptance criteria:
- The customer enters card details and confirms the payment.
- After a successful payment the invoice is marked as paid.
- When the bank declines the card, the customer sees why and can try another card.

description: The story and the security policy give different session timeouts.

sources.title: ACC-14 Log out inactive users
sources.content:
Type: story
Description:
Inactive users are logged out to protect their accounts.
Acceptance criteria:
- The session expires after 30 minutes of inactivity.
- The user is redirected to the login page with a message.

sources.title: Security policy — sessions
sources.content: Sessions of the customer portal end after 15 minutes without activity. The limit is required by the bank's audit.

description: A Polish story and an English policy disagree on the refund window.

sources.title: SHOP-77 Zwrot zamówienia
sources.content:

Description:

Acceptance criteria:
- Zwrot jest możliwy do 14 dni od dostawy.
- Po przyjęciu zwrotu klient dostaje e-mail z potwierdzeniem.

sources.title: Returns policy
sources.content: Customers can return any order within 30 days of delivery. Returned items must be unused.

sources.title: ACC-30 Change the account e-mail
sources.content:
Type: story
Description:
A logged-in customer changes the e-mail address of the account.
Acceptance criteria:
- The customer enters the new address and the current password.
- A wrong password shows "The password is incorrect" and nothing changes.
- An address used by another account shows "This e-mail is already in use".
- The new address is active after the customer clicks the link sent to it; the link is valid for 24 hours.
- Until then the old address stays active and receives a notice about the change.

sources.title: Account e-mail changes
sources.content: A change of the account e-mail needs the current password. The new address is confirmed by a link valid for 24 hours; the old address stays active until confirmation and gets a notice.

sources.content:
Frame: Change e-mail
Text layers: New e-mail | Current password | Save | The password is incorrect | This e-mail is already in use | Check your inbox to confirm the new address

- The choice applies immediately without reloading the page.
- The choice is saved in the user's profile and applies on every device after the next login.
